summary: Successfully tested Automated Project Matching feature. All backend APIs (7 tests) and frontend UI features (15 test cases) passed. Project Matching tab visible in admin sidebar, create project form works with all required fields, project cards display correctly, matches view shows ranked experts with combined score weighting (70% match + 30% verification).
passed_tests: Backend API Tests (7/7 passed):
- POST /api/admin/project-requirements creates project requirement
- GET /api/admin/project-requirements returns all projects
- GET /api/admin/project-requirements?status=open filters by status
- GET /api/admin/project-requirements/{id}/matches returns ranked experts
- GET /api/admin/project-requirements/{nonexistent}/matches returns 404
- Protected endpoints require auth (401/403 without token)
- Matches endpoint requires auth
Frontend UI Tests (15/15 passed):
- Admin login and dashboard loads successfully
- Project Matching tab appears in admin sidebar
- Project Matching page loads with AdminProjectMatching component (data-testid='admin-project-matching')
- Projects tab shows project count (e.g., 'Projects (5)')
- Matches tab available but disabled until project selected
- New Project button opens create project form modal
- Create project form has all required fields:
- Basic Information: title (data-testid='project-title-input'), description (data-testid='project-description-input')
- Sectors Required: toggleable sector buttons
- Skills: categorized skill buttons (Research, Data, M&E, Technical) with required/preferred designation
- Requirements: min experience, positions, duration, engagement type, start date, budget
- Sector selection toggles correctly (button turns red when selected)
- Skills selection works with click for required
- Create & Find Matches button submits form and creates project
- Project cards display: title, description, sectors, experience, duration, positions, status badge
- Clicking project card switches to Matches tab and shows matching experts
- Match cards display: rank badge (#1, #2, etc.), expert name, email, combined score
- Match score breakdown shows: Match Score bar (70% weight) and Verification bar (30% weight)
- Expert details show: years experience, availability, daily rate, trust tier badge (Gold/Silver/Bronze)
- Matching sectors and skills displayed on match cards
- Contact and View Profile buttons present
- Refresh matches button (data-testid='refresh-matches-btn') works
- Tab switching between Projects and Matches works correctly
